item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-04b73a73d5175321","start_unit":10,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"The 2022 victim-reparation law established an interinstitutional commission under the President and a public fund for victims’ access to justice, compensation, empowerment, and community recovery, with defined governance and funding sources including budget subsidies and 11% of mining royalties.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","6B.1","6B.3","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The law entered into force before 2023 and remained the applicable institutional framework during 2023; the supplied text establishes legal design, not implementation outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The law was promulgated by President Félix Tshisekedi; operational responsibility was shared with the Government and Prime Minister.","limitations":["No evidence here establishes the fund’s actual 2023 disbursements, staffing, or geographic reach."]},{"source_id":"SRC-04b73a73d5175321","start_unit":14,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"The law created judicial, administrative, and social protections for conflict victims, including free procedures, legal assistance, witness and victim protection, confidential hearings, health care, rehabilitation, compensation, restitution, satisfaction, guarantees of non-repetition, and vetting.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","6B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The statutory protections were in force during 2023; the supplied text does not show their enforcement or results during that year.","ruler_attribution":"The framework was promulgated under Tshisekedi, while courts, prosecutors, security services, and the victim fund were assigned implementation roles.","limitations":["The source provides no 2023 enforcement statistics or findings on abuse remediation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ecdc1fd735af8049","start_unit":2,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The 2022 budget-governance decree established three-year fiscal planning through a medium-term budget framework, required analysis of macroeconomic, debt, institutional, corruption, disaster, and health risks, and provided for consultations with provinces, civil society, and technical partners before adoption.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","8B.2","8B.5"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The decree’s relevant provisions were immediately applicable during 2023; the text shows formal rules rather than evidence of 2023 compliance.","ruler_attribution":"The decree was issued by the Prime Minister within the Tshisekedi administration; implementation was assigned primarily to the Government and budget authorities.","limitations":["No 2023 execution or outcome data is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ecdc1fd735af8049","start_unit":14,"end_unit":19,"fact_summary":"The decree linked programs to objectives, indicators, annual performance plans and reports, assigned political and technical responsibilities, required qualified existing officials for program leadership, and mandated management dialogue and reporting.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.6","5B.7","8B.2","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"These institutional rules applied during 2023, but the supplied source does not demonstrate actual performance in that year.","ruler_attribution":"The decree formed part of the executive budget-governance framework under Tshisekedi’s administration.","limitations":["No evidence identifies specific 2023 appointments or completed program milestones."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ecdc1fd735af8049","start_unit":23,"end_unit":30,"fact_summary":"The decree required internal controls, independent and objective internal audit, risk committees, audit committees with an external competent member, prior budgetary review, treasury planning, and publication of detailed budget, debt, fiscal-risk, execution, and citizen-budget information.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","6B.5","7B.6","7B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The relevant provisions were immediately applicable during 2023; this is evidence of formal safeguards, not proof of operation or compliance.","ruler_attribution":"The framework was adopted by the executive branch during Tshisekedi’s tenure; implementation depended on ministers, inspectors, auditors, and budget controllers.","limitations":["No supplied evidence confirms publication timeliness, audit independence in practice, or corrective action during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-acb5869974789a28","start_unit":163,"end_unit":170,"fact_summary":"UNFPA’s 2023 DRC programme data reports $23.25 million for reducing gender-based violence and harmful practices, $15.88 million for gender and social norms, $6.13 million for quality of care and services, and $4.49 million for accelerating reductions in preventable maternal deaths; government implementation shares were 4%, 3%, 3%, and 14%, respectively.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The figures are explicitly for 2023 programme activities.","ruler_attribution":"The data describes UNFPA-supported programmes implemented by UNFPA, NGOs, government, and the UN; it does not establish that Tshisekedi personally directed or financed the reported outcomes.","limitations":["The source reports spending and implementing entities, not outcome attainment or national government performance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-11962174f401851b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"The DRC’s extractive-sector transparency framework included public mining-license and petroleum-contract registries, beneficial-ownership disclosure provisions, and direct distribution rules for mining royalties; EITI reported a high 2022 implementation score of 85.5.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7","7B.3","7B.6","7B.9","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The institutional findings primarily concern the 2018–2022 period and provide context for 2023, not a standalone 2023 result.","ruler_attribution":"The framework operated under the DRC executive and EITI multi-stakeholder group during Tshisekedi’s presidency.","limitations":["The page also identifies weaknesses: no public beneficial-ownership registry, incomplete disclosures, and prior failures to distribute revenues to local levels."]},{"source_id":"SRC-11962174f401851b","start_unit":12,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"The EITI validation found strong public debate, open-data publication, stakeholder engagement, and follow-up mechanisms, but only partly met beneficial-ownership transparency: of 77 significant extractive licensees, 21 submitted ownership information, while 56 companies had disclosed owners after additional collection.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","5B.5","5B.7","7B.4","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"These findings concern the EITI validation period ending in 2022 and are contextual evidence available during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern state institutions and the EITI multi-stakeholder group, not solely Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not establish a 2023 presidential intervention or correction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-11962174f401851b","start_unit":25,"end_unit":27,"fact_summary":"During 2023, Tshisekedi instructed the government to negotiate an accelerated MONUSCO withdrawal, moving the intended start from December 2024 to December 2023; the DRC and MONUSCO signed a disengagement plan on 21 November, and the Security Council then initiated a gradual, responsible withdrawal while extending the mission through December 2024.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The decisions and agreements occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source directly attributes the withdrawal instruction to President Tshisekedi and records subsequent government negotiations.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether accelerated withdrawal improved security or civilian protection."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1ca70efabd2771c7","start_unit":25,"end_unit":27,"fact_summary":"During 2023, the DRC accused Rwanda of deploying troops and supporting M23, while Rwanda accused the DRC of collaborating with and arming the FDLR and other armed groups; the UN Security Council condemned external support to M23 and certain armed groups, and a UN expert report found further evidence of direct Rwandan interventions and troop reinforcements in eastern DRC.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.5","2B.6","2B.9","3B.6","3B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The accusations, UN statements, and expert findings concern 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The DRC position was presented by the government and its representatives; the source does not independently establish Tshisekedi’s personal responsibility for any alleged support to armed groups.","limitations":["The allegations by the DRC and Rwanda are contested; the expert finding addresses Rwanda’s conduct and does not resolve all allegations concerning the DRC."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1ca70efabd2771c7","start_unit":26,"end_unit":27,"fact_summary":"The DRC declined to extend the EAC Regional Force mandate beyond 8 December 2023 after criticizing its failure to enforce M23’s withdrawal; an SADC mission was deployed on 15 December to support the DRC government in restoring peace and security in the east.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.10","3B.6","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The mandate decision and SADC deployment occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The decision was attributed to the DRC government; the source does not specify the exact presidential order beyond the broader executive role.","limitations":["The source provides no 2023 evidence that the replacement force achieved durable security gains."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-3d224ca8cacf4737"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied documents provide many formal laws, institutional designs, contested security claims, and programme-financing figures, but limited direct evidence of Tshisekedi’s personal decisions, implementation quality, or measurable 2023 outcomes.","The ICJ case page concerns Ukraine v. Russia rather than the DRC or Tshisekedi and contains no material fact for the supplied lenses."]}
